messages:
Tanya (PM): Quick thread to lock the MVP cutlist before EOD. Two risky items: post-training quantized model shipping and the new realtime reranking path for embeddings. Both help cost but add infra/runtime risk. Thoughts?
Ilya (Infra): Quantized runtime needs a different kernel set and CI perf baselines. If we ship it now we risk unseen p99 regressions. Recommend move to v1 unless perf wins are huge.
Ben (ML): Measured token cost drop ~22% in staging with quantization, but p99 increases in long-tail sequences. Also need runtime fallbacks for unsupported hardware.
Kiran (Sales): A few large prospects asked for low-cost inference (quantization) as key for procurement. They might pay for an early-availability pilot. Can we gate it behind pilot flags?
Zoe (Design): If quantize is pilot-only, we need visible labeling in Console and documentation so SEs don't promise public availability. I'll make a small "Pilot: Quantized inference" badge and copy.
Tanya (PM): Proposed compromise: cut public-quantize from MVP, enable quantized models for Dedicated and an invite-only pilot behind a feature flag. For embeddings rerank path, it's higher risk — prefer to keep the simpler batched rerank now and postpone the realtime reranker to v1.
Ilya (Infra): Sounds right. Plan: 1) add feature flag (per-tenant) for quantize, 2) ensure runtime fallback to full-precision model if kernel missing, 3) document rollback. I can scope as ~4 dev-days across infra + runtime.
Ben (ML): For pilots, I can run parity and p99 tests and provide a checklist for SEs. Will also add an automated drift check.
Kiran (Sales): Pilot timeline: customers want pilot enablement within 2 weeks of flag readiness. SE docs + onboarding script needed.
Zoe (Design): I'll drop badge + onboarding microcopy tomorrow. Also suggest "Try quantized inference (pilot)" CTA on tenant settings.
ops-bot: Canary policy: public-mvp deploy blocked until core p95 < 350ms across primary regions.
Tanya (PM): Action items: 
- Tanya: update public MVP one-pager + roadmap snapshot (today).
- Ilya: implement feature flag + fallback plan (PR by Wed).
- Ben: parity + p99 checklist for pilots (post-PR).
- Zoe: badge + CTA copy (tomorrow).
- Kiran: communicate pilot compromise to prospects and collect pilot signups (by Fri).
Ilya (Infra): I'll also run a quick perf sweep: if quantize p99 impact < 5% we can re-evaluate lifting the cut.
Ben (ML): Agreed. If perf looks neutral we can fast-track.
Tanya (PM): OK reconvene Thu 9am to review perf numbers and pilot interest. If any strategic customer says quantize is non-negotiable for MVP, escalate to the exec steering channel.
Kiran (Sales): Will surface any hard blockers asap.
Tanya (PM): Thanks all 44d
